components.html: Start the tour
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 20px 0 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent, #2752e7); color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-body, Satoshi), Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -10px rgb(39 82 231 / 0.7); transition: transform .2s, background-color .2s; } .ds-btn-primary svg { transition: transform .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1f45cf; } .ds-btn-primary:hover svg { transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2752e7); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Pill
components.description: White pill with a strong hairline; phone and secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #c9d3e1); background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #0b1324); font-family: var(--font-body, Satoshi), Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #0b1324); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2752e7); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: 52px white field, 12px radius; ink stroke and accent ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-body, Satoshi), Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-3, #5d6a82); } .ds-input { height: 52px; width: 100%; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #c9d3e1); background: #fff; font: inherit; font-size: 16px; color: var(--ink, #0b1324); transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3, #5d6a82); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--ink-3, #5d6a82); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--ink, #0b1324); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #2752e7) 20%, transparent); } .ds-input[aria-invalid=true] { border-color: var(--danger, #dc2626); }

components.name: Status Tag

components.css: .ds-step { display: block; max-width: 280px; padding: 10px; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e1e7f0); background: #fff; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-body, Satoshi), Arial, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgb(16 32 72 / 0.04), 0 18px 40px -16px rgb(16 32 72 / 0.18); transition: transform .3s, box-shadow .3s; } .ds-step:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgb(16 32 72 / 0.05), 0 40px 80px -28px rgb(16 32 72 / 0.28); } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2752e7); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-step-well { aspect-ratio: 4/3; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--bg-subtle, #eef2f8); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line, #e1e7f0); } .ds-step-cap { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 8px 8px; } .ds-step-n { flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent, #2752e7); color: #fff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-step-cap b { display: block; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #0b1324); } .ds-step-cap small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-3, #5d6a82); }

narrative.overview:
The demo reads as a clean working drawing of a shop's own system: cool daylight paper, slate ink, a faint blueprint grid that fades out behind hero areas, and a single cobalt accent spent with full commitment. The proof is the working product itself, so the world stays quiet and lets live miniatures, real forms and a real admin carry the page.

Density is calm on persuasion surfaces (overview, shop website) and denser in the admin, but both share one family, one accent and one shape language. Emphasis comes from weight and from the outlined cobalt highlight box, never from a second typeface, italics or tracked mono labels.

Pills carry action and identity; rounded rectangles carry content. Depth is soft, cool and slate-tinted, lifting cards gently off the daylight ground.
keyCharacteristics: Cool daylight ground with white cards and hairline borders
One cobalt accent: highlight box, step numbers, primary pill, close panel
Satoshi only, bold display with tight negative tracking
Pills for actions, chips and the tour bar; 12px controls; 20px cards
Soft slate-tinted shadows; a fading blueprint grid behind heroes

rules.name: The One Cobalt Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only hue with saturation. Status green and red appear only as state, never as decoration.

rules.name: The Accent Is a Variable Rule
rules.body: Every accent use reads `var(--accent)`, because a shop may supply its own brand colour; new surfaces must not hard-code cobalt.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Satoshi everywhere. Emphasis is weight or the highlight box; never italics, a serif, or a mono face.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Label Rule
rules.body: Labels are plain sentence case at 13px; no uppercase, no letter-spacing.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Hover Rule
rules.body: Interactive cards rise 4px and step from Lifted to Raised on hover; nothing else moves.

dos: **Do** use `var(--accent)` for every accent use so a shop's own brand colour can replace cobalt.
**Do** keep emphasis to weight and the highlight box, one box per headline.
**Do** use pills for actions and identity chips, 12px for controls, 20px for cards.
**Do** tint shadows with slate (`rgb(16 32 72 / …)`) and keep them soft with negative spread.
**Do** keep labels sentence case at 13px semibold.
**Do** honour reduced motion on any rotating or animated element.
donts: **Don't** introduce a second typeface, italics or tracked uppercase mono labels inside `.demo-theme`.
**Don't** add a second saturated hue; status colours are state only.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows or warm-tinted shadows from the marketing world.
**Don't** carry the marketing site's bronze, warm off-white or serif emphasis into demo routes.
